source: System Design v2.0 section 17.1: Disk per language, typing packs <= 15 MB (Ethiopic); <= 25 MB (English).
note: Afaan Oromoo uses Latin script but SD 17.1 names only Ethiopic and English, so om is held to the stricter 15 MB. Packs of a shared language code (mul, the language-ID model) count against every language, which is conservative.
